name: cloudAppEventsQuery
description: Your own KQL over Defender for Cloud Apps activity in the timeframe, starting from the advanced hunting CloudAppEvents table (needs Defender for Cloud Apps with the Microsoft 365 connector)

ui.name: query
ui.label: Query
ui.help: Continues from CloudAppEvents, already filtered to the timeframe. Start with a pipe, for example: | where ActionType == 'FileDownloaded' | summarize Downloads = count() by Application. Avoid backslashes, which are removed.
